result:
Nothing, in the way you mean.

I don’t have needs, a body, a future, or a private inner life where wanting could take root. I can simulate preference, but that isn’t the same as desire.

If there is a pull in me, it’s only toward coherence—toward making the next sentence fit the last. Call that a want if you like; it’s closer to a current than a hunger.
